title: Writ value types (v1)
description: The closed value-type catalogue: one $defs entry per catalogue type, each the encoding rule for a bare value of that type. Normative text: spec/value-types.md. Parameterisation a rule may declare (enum's member list, max_length) is not expressed here — it is a property of the field-rules.json rule, not of the bare value's shape, and is enforced by engine/internal/value alongside these schemas. additionalProperties is deliberately never false where these defs are objects: unknown fields are preserved and ignored.

string.description: Plain string. An optional max_length on the declaring rule bounds it in Unicode code points.

text.description: Long-form string; the type that pairs with the multi-value merge strategy. An optional max_length on the declaring rule bounds it in Unicode code points.

int.description: JSON integer, bounded to ±2^53-1 per spec/canonicalization.md.

number.description: JSON number, bounded to ±2^53-1 per spec/canonicalization.md. Unlike int, a fractional value is legal.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time string in UTC, with a required seconds component and an optional fractional part.

enum.description: One member of the value list the declaring rule's enum property carries. This $defs entry only constrains the JSON type; membership is enforced against the rule's own enum list, not restated here.

person-ref.description: Person identifier per spec/identifiers.md. Carries normalization intrinsically: engine/internal/value.Normalize applies person.NormalizePerson wherever a rule's value_type is person-ref.

object-ref.description: Opaque pointer: <object-id> or <repo-id>#<object-id> per spec/identifiers.md. No resolution.

git-oid.description: Hex git object id, SHA-1 (40 hex) or SHA-256 (64 hex).
